message.content:
A nonstop commercial flight from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) to Miami International Airport (MIA) typically takes **about 5½ to 6 hours** of air time.  

- **Typical flight time:** ~5 hours 30 minutes  
- **Factors that can affect it:**  
  - Wind direction and speed (tailwinds can shave off time, headwinds can add it)  
  - Specific routing chosen by the airline (some may take slightly longer or shorter paths)  
  - Aircraft type and cruising speed  

So if you’re planning a trip, expect roughly five and a half hours of flight time, but always check the airline’s published schedule for the exact duration on your chosen flight.
